verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Basecamp feature that uses AI to draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity. Official MCP support for ChatGPT and Claude, the CLI and Skills, and inviting AI agents are integration building blocks that belong to other stories, not a documented status-drafting capability. Automatic check-ins collect answers from people, not AI-generated summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
